dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures in the mid-body display a gradient transition from dark background pixels to lighter interior marking pixels, with outer perimeters showing irregular, non-uniform curvature.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density; characterized by a single, high-intensity core pixel concentration on the lower-lateral flank and a secondary cluster at the cervical-cranial junction.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the mid-lateral high-intensity blob, the primary 'O' shaped annulus, and the cervical cluster form an obtuse scalene triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: A singular, circular high-intensity point on the lower flank which exhibits higher pixel intensity and tighter spatial concentration than the surrounding reticulated pattern.
